title: The clients open originals by different rules: the web needs the extension, the phone falls back to the stored type
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/DocumentPage.swift:157-177 (previewName) vs widget-src/src/lib/file-kinds.ts:14-25 (viewableType). Fable ruled 2026-11-11: (R4) one rule in health-core file-kinds for both clients. The extension decides; with no extension, the stored type decides. Both go through the same allow-list, and nothing outside it opens. Security class (adversary + Codex). iPhone survey 2026-11-11 (main fcc4ed9b) L10
